comment: The RATE knob is configured as configParam(RATE_PARAM, -2, 6, 2, "Rate", " Hz") with no display base or multiplier, so its tooltip reads -2 Hz to 6 Hz while the clock it sets is pow(2, value) hertz, 0.25Hz to 64Hz. The panel prints RATE, R, X0, RESET, EXT CLOCK and OUT; the maker's parameter name for the X0 knob is just X. Index order is not panel order for the jacks: the R input is index 2 and sits highest, the clock input is index 0 and sits lowest but one. Every port has a jack.
